title: Bassoon
summary: No render yet. No complete bassoon air column is published in open sources: only ten tone holes of one German bassoon and nine of a different French one, a straight test bocal and a few global dimensions.
physics_present: generic fs-duct conical and cylindrical segments, tone-hole side branches and a flanged bell load, the lumped single-reed owner and the physical baffled outlet receiver already run for the clarinet; none has been given this instrument's geometry
Fuks and Sundberg 1996 blowing pressures for two professional bassoon players are retained as player data
physics_missing: bore profile of the bocal, wing, boot, long joint and bell
positions and sizes of most tone holes, pads and key rise, and a fingering chart
a double-reed valve driving this bore
a single specimen: the two partial hole tables belong to different instruments and must not be merged
blocked: No complete published bassoon geometry; needs the measured bore and hole tables from the authors of the Detmold, Marseille or Bordeaux bassoon studies, or an owner measurement.
